title: Socioeconomic risk factors and obstetric outcomes of adolescent pregnancies in Vietnam.

Percentage of fetal age at first prenatal visit  Adolescent pregnancies (red) had a lower percentage of first prenatal visits at an early stage (5 weeks) and a higher percentage of late visits (over 12 weeks) compared to adult pregnancies (blue), which had 100% of first prenatal visits within the first trimester.
